objective.statement: Keep every committed, release-marked Ming skill synchronized with its own public GitHub product repository.
objective.per_run_success: all products pass source, metadata, package, README, and provenance checks, or unsafe findings are recorded without publication
non_goals: rewriting a skill's product purpose without approval

freeze.manifest: products.json plus per-skill git tree hash
freeze.hash_algorithm: git sha1/sha256 as configured by the repository

sensor.name: monitor-products
sensor.signal: registry and standalone repository drift findings
sensor.collection: scripts/monitor-products reads committed git trees and GitHub API state

comparator.rule: compare each committed skill tree and products.json metadata with SOURCE.json, repository metadata, README, and packaged SKILL.md
comparator.window: current source commit and live GitHub state

actions: run scripts/publish-skill for a ready named skill
update ignored runtime state after independent verification
actuator.feedback_path: rerun scripts/monitor-products and advance the last-good cursor only on a full pass

triggers.condition: daily through a local Codex automation
triggers.dedupe_key: skill name plus committed source tree hash

state.recovery: failed runs preserve the last-good cursor; rerun the deterministic audit after repair

roles.name: orchestrator
roles.responsibility: run preflight and route only confirmed findings

roles.name: executor
roles.responsibility: repair a ready product through publish-skill-product and scripts/publish-skill
may_write: named source product and standalone repository
may_not: change protected policy or unrelated dirty files

roles.name: verifier
roles.responsibility: re-read source and live remote surfaces after execution

capabilities.reason: the loop uses fixed registry scripts and the publish-skill-product skill; new capabilities require a contract revision

autonomous_actions: republish a ready product through the repository publisher
approval_required: change a skill's purpose or story
publish an uncommitted or unlisted skill

acceptance_checks: remote SOURCE.json tree equals the committed source tree
root README contains canonical install command and Author
failure_path_checks: missing GitHub or git commands fail closed
state cursor does not advance when any finding remains
evidence_required: standalone install discovery for repaired products
verification.pass_rule: all deterministic checks pass and repaired products pass independent install verification

failure_policy.classification: source-dirty vs source-validation vs authentication vs network vs remote-drift vs install failure
failure_policy.rollback: publisher changes are additive git commits; revert the named product commit and keep the previous state cursor
failure_policy.kill: disable the Codex automation and remove .skill-product-monitor/LOCK if no process holds it

runtime_safety.idempotency_key: skill name plus committed source tree hash
runtime_safety.tenant_scope: Ming's m1nga/skills registry and m1nga/<skill-name> repositories only
runtime_safety.secrets: GitHub authentication supplied by gh; no token is stored in the repository or runtime state

observability.status_view: .skill-product-monitor/RUN-STATE.json and events.jsonl plus Codex automation run status

replacement.atomic_promotion: contract and automation prompt update in one reviewed registry commit
replacement.inactive_history: git history and disabled automation history

conditions: monitor moved to another verified system
cleanup: finish or report outstanding publication work
retirement.history_visibility: inactive contract remains in git history and is excluded from active automation
